verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's homepage claims built-in agents that continuously monitor the product and surface insights, plus in-product AI that spots trends across replays and summarizes them. This is the product's own AI, but the evidence is marketing copy only and shows no conversational assistant that users hand tasks to. The hosted MCP server serves external AI assistants, which is a different story, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of an in-product assistant users can delegate tasks to, the scope of actions it can perform, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Agents monitor your product continuously, surface insights before you think to ask, and tell your team exactly what to do next.
Use AI to spot trends across hundreds of replays and heatmaps
